# Best waterproof Bluetooth speakers for the pool or beach

**JBL Charge 6 is the best all-rounder.** It has an IP68 rating, 20 hours of battery (28 with Playtime Boost), and it doubles as a power bank. What Hi-Fi lists it at about $130 at Walmart and $150 at Amazon. [What Hi-Fi's pick](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart) | [BestProducts review](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/)

## Other picks by need

| Need | Pick | Why | Where to buy |
|---|---|---|---|
| Big pool party | JBL Boombox 4 | RTINGS' top waterproof pick. It floats, handles long immersion, and lasts 40+ hours. Its sound is narrow, so it's muffled off to the sides. | [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth) |
| Sound all around the pool | Ultimate Ears Epicboom | Tom's Guide's best overall and RTINGS' mid-range pick. It has 360° sound, IP67, floats, and gets 15 hours. | [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers) |
| Budget | Ultimate Ears Wonderboom 4 | IP67, floats, and gets about 14 hours. It was about $65 in BestProducts' list. | [BestProducts](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/) |
| Easy to pack | JBL Grip (about $100) | IP68, under a pound, can-shaped, and Good Housekeeping's best overall. Its mesh body can look dusty after the beach. | [Good Housekeeping](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/what-to-buy/a71783745/best-waterproof-speakers/) |
| Cheapest | JBL Go 5 (about $40) | IP67 and soap-sized, but only 8 hours of battery. | [What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart) |

## A deal on a party speaker
The **Soundcore Boom 2 Plus** is a 100 W speaker that floats, is rated IPX7, and gets about 20 hours at half volume. It is heavy at 3.8 kg, and its dust rating isn't listed, so keep it on a towel at the beach. Dealectric reports that code AFSC20 took $49.99 off in Soundcore's cart on Oct 22, bringing $249.99 down to $200. The code expires 2026-12-31. This is an affiliate link, and checkout has the final word on price. [Buy at Soundcore via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-boom-2-plus) | [Details](https://dealectric.com/soundcore-boom-2-plus)

## Tips
- Look for at least IP67, or IPX7 for the pool. For sand, also look for a dust rating (IP6X).
- IP ratings don't cover salt or chlorine corrosion. RTINGS recommends rinsing with fresh water after use. Check your model's manual first, and let it dry fully before charging ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth)).
- Keep the charging port flap closed, and set the speaker where a splash can't knock it into the water.

If you tell me your budget and whether you're after portable or party-loud, I can narrow it to one.
